title: 2019 年 6 月英语六级真题（第 1 套）

units.task: 议论文写作，围绕"职场中团队精神与沟通的重要性"展开论述，字数150-200词。
outline: 开篇引出话题：在竞争激烈的职场环境中，团队精神与沟通不可或缺。
主体段分两层论证：一是有效沟通能减少误解、提升效率；二是团队精神能凝聚力量、激发潜能，产生协同效应。
结尾总结呼吁：企业应重视培养协作文化，方能获得竞争优势与可持续发展。
units.sample:
In today's increasingly competitive business environment, team spirit and communication have become indispensable qualities in the workplace. Their importance can hardly be overstated.

To begin with, effective communication serves as the cornerstone of successful collaboration. When colleagues exchange ideas openly and listen to each other attentively, misunderstandings are minimized and productivity is significantly enhanced. Furthermore, a strong sense of team spirit fosters mutual trust and a shared commitment to common goals. Employees who feel connected to their team are more likely to go the extra mile and contribute their best efforts.

Moreover, the synergy generated by cohesive teamwork often yields results far superior to what individuals could achieve alone. Complex projects demand diverse skills and perspectives, and only through seamless cooperation can organizations navigate challenges and seize opportunities effectively.

In conclusion, cultivating team spirit and promoting open communication should be a top priority for every organization. Companies that invest in building collaborative cultures will undoubtedly gain a competitive edge and achieve sustainable success in the long run.

phrases.cn: 充当……的基石；用于强调某事物的根本性地位
付出额外努力、不遗余力；地道习语，展示词汇深度

phrases.en: a shared commitment to common goals
phrases.cn: 对共同目标的共同承诺；体现团队凝聚力的高分表达

phrases.en: the synergy generated by cohesive teamwork
phrases.cn: 紧密协作所产生的协同效应；synergy 为商务与学术高频词
获得竞争优势；edge 比 advantage 更书面、更精练
应对挑战并抓住机遇；动词搭配精准，句式工整
培养相互信任；foster 比 build 更正式，适合议论文
产出远优于……的成果；superior to 替代 better than 更高级
从长远来看；用于结尾段总结展望

pitfalls: 审题偏差：只谈沟通或只谈团队精神，未兼顾题目中的两个关键词
论证空洞：仅有观点无具体解释或例证，缺乏说服力
词汇重复：反复使用 important/very 等低级词，未做同义替换
逻辑松散：段落间缺乏过渡衔接词，结构不清晰
字数违规：低于150词或超过200词均会扣分，需提前规划篇幅

upgrades.plain: Team spirit is very important in the workplace.
upgrades.better: Team spirit has become an indispensable quality in the workplace.
upgrades.note: 用 indispensable 替换 very important，词汇更高级且避免口语化

upgrades.plain: Good communication can help people work better.
upgrades.better: Effective communication serves as the cornerstone of successful collaboration.
upgrades.note: 使用隐喻 cornerstone 增强表现力，serve as 结构更正式

upgrades.plain: A team can do more things than one person.
upgrades.better: The synergy generated by cohesive teamwork often yields results far superior to what individuals could achieve alone.
upgrades.note: synergy、cohesive、superior to 等词显著提升学术语感与句式复杂度

upgrades.plain: Companies should pay attention to teamwork.
upgrades.better: Cultivating team spirit and promoting open communication should be a top priority for every organization.
upgrades.note: 动名词作主语使句式多样，top priority 比 pay attention to 更有力度

upgrades.plain: Only by working together can we solve problems.
upgrades.better: Only through seamless cooperation can organizations navigate challenges and seize opportunities effectively.
upgrades.note: 倒装句保留的同时升级词汇，seamless、navigate 展示词汇广度

band9: Effective communication serves as the cornerstone of successful collaboration. — 有效沟通是成功协作的基石。（隐喻+正式搭配，适合论证段首句）
Employees who feel connected to their team are more likely to go the extra mile and contribute their best efforts. — 对团队有归属感的员工更愿意不遗余力地贡献自己的力量。（定语从句+习语，句式丰满）
The synergy generated by cohesive teamwork often yields results far superior to what individuals could achieve alone. — 紧密协作产生的协同效应往往远超个人所能取得的成果。（过去分词后置定语+superior to+what从句，语法密度高）
Only through seamless cooperation can organizations navigate challenges and seize opportunities effectively. — 唯有通过无缝合作，组织才能有效应对挑战、把握机遇。（only+介词短语引导的倒装句，考场亮点句型）
Companies that invest in building collaborative cultures will undoubtedly gain a competitive edge in the long run. — 致力于构建协作文化的企业无疑将在长远中获得竞争优势。（定语从句+高级词汇收束全文）
